svg.title: Final input cost and total CPU comparison
svg.desc: Task per value, long-lived task, and swift-debounce: send costs 798, 216, and 16 ns; total process CPU 280.81, 21.91, and 1.72 ms. Medians of 15 rounds for 100,000 inputs. CPU covers output and settling beyond the synchronous loop. The two panels use separate zero-based scales and observation windows.
